description: Auxiliary: the only case configuring per-rule suppress_namespaces and suppress_paths (RuleExclusionStats' two ledger halves) and the only one pairing them with a top-level suppress_namespaces (the global namespace-suppression stage) in one run, silencing four fixtures that would otherwise fire code-smell.long-parameter-list. The global suppress_paths stage is witnessed separately by the excluded-path case. The fourth fixture, SuppressedInsideExcluded, is the only place in the corpus where a suppression sits on a finding the ledger throws away: it reports nothing today because the directive audit reads what the run produced, and would report annotation.unused-directive if it read what a report published.
